title: More realistic food
description: This data pack makes the food system in Minecraft more realistic!
body:
This data pack makes the food system in Minecraft more realistic! Eating food now takes significantly longer—on average, about 10 times longer. Different foods have different consumption rates: some are eaten faster, while others take longer. Also, some previously inedible items can now be eaten.

Furthermore, the entity limit has been changed: a single block can now hold a maximum of 5 entities instead of the standard 24, which helps improve balance and performance.
